type: Generated illustrative property cutaway, separate from Halo's real gallery photography.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: clean photoreal architectural cutaway illustration for the interactive hero of Halo Property Inspection in Dubai, no UI or typography.
Create a gorgeous highly detailed three-quarter axonometric dollhouse cutaway of a single modern Dubai apartment, isolated as a tangible architectural miniature, landscape composition about 4:3. Warm white oak flooring, cream plaster walls, pale limestone surfaces, elegant restrained contemporary furnishings, sage textiles, believable full-size architectural proportions. The entire model is visible with breathing room around all edges, very little wasted space, elevated viewpoint looking into the rooms.
Layout is important for interactive inspection points: a light modern kitchen occupies the BACK LEFT, a compact tiled bathroom with shower, basin and toilet occupies the BACK RIGHT, a living area with pale sofa and coffee table occupies the FRONT LEFT and centre, and a small glazed balcony occupies the FRONT RIGHT. Partial walls and removed roof allow the rooms to be seen. A compact visible rectangular AC supply grille high on the living-room wall. Kitchen tap and sink visible. Bathroom shower screen and wall joints visible. No bedroom is necessary. Apartment functions and room connections must be believable.
One realistically proportioned professional property inspector in a plain dark forest green polo and dark trousers stands in the kitchen, holding a compact inspection tablet and using a small handheld moisture meter against an accessible wall. Face secondary and unobtrusive, anatomically plausible hands. No invasive openings, no giant cracks, no obvious disasters. This model illustrates non-invasive property inspection.
Make the cutaway feel exquisite and physical, tactile materials, architectural precision, soft natural daylight, beautiful softly feathered grounding shadow. Cream, ivory, forest green and muted sage palette. Apartment surfaces detailed but uncluttered. Background is transparent so the model can sit in an ivory website layout. Preserve natural feathered shadows as translucent alpha. No platform enclosing the model, no large garden, no vehicle.
Constraints: no words, labels, symbols, text, watermark, logos, hotspots, report sheets, arrows, measurement grids, neon overlays or user interface. The website will add all interaction and labels in real code. Avoid cartoon illustration, toy-like giant figures, impossible perspective, stacks of extra floors and distorted doors.
